name: ^context\.(onBlockingQuestion|onDetachedResult|onResultRead|messageChild|dispatchSubagents|transformText|parent\.ask|parent\.note)$
reason: Hooks the run supplies on the tool context; the trace checks each call's arguments and the twin takes the hook's answer as input.

name: ^actions\.(sendImages|reactToMessage)$
reason: Channel adapter actions the tool context supplies; the trace checks the arguments and the twin takes the adapter's answer.

name: ^(sendSticker|dispatch|loadSkillPrompt|toSandboxCall)$
reason: Callback handed to the tool factory as a parameter; the trace checks its arguments and the twin takes its answer as input.

name: ^accessClients\.(get|set)$
reason: Module WeakMap caching one S3 client per access config; a WeakMap cannot be listed, so the twin takes each lookup's answer and states the key and the client it stores.

name: ^standIn\.execute\.bind$
reason: Function.prototype.bind of the stand-in tool's execute method; the twin states the result is that tool's execute.
